scripts.text: ^FF0000 Check up your inventory. You got too many items to carry out the quest. ^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000你攜帶的物品太多，無法繼續任務，請先整理背包。^000000

scripts.text: Have you ever heard of horrific human experimentation committed in Rekenber Corporation whose head office is here in Lighthalzen?
scripts.translation: 你聽說過雷根貝勒公司在總部所在地裡希塔樂鎮進行可怕的人體實驗嗎？

scripts.text: There are a lot of rumors that horrible human experimentation is actually performed, but these people in the slum....don't want to believe that due to the welfare movement from Rekenber.
scripts.translation: 有很多傳聞說他們真的在做可怕的人體實驗，可貧民區的這些人...因為雷根貝勒的福利活動，不願相信這種事。

scripts.text: Well! and those rich people, seem to know something but they never mention that...
scripts.translation: 還有那些有錢人，好像知道些什麼，卻從來不提...

scripts.text: Ahh!! And this is a secret that just SOME PEOPLE know. I heard that from Rekenber Lab.,.. a person named...um...Wol....
scripts.translation: 啊！！而且這只是少數人才知道的秘密。我聽雷根貝勒研究所裡一個叫...呃...沃爾...的人說的。

scripts.text: Anyway!! A scientist named Wolf.. something suddenly got sacked. and he must be related with this rumor, I think...
scripts.translation: 總之！！有個叫沃爾夫...什麼的科學家突然被解僱了。我想他一定和這個傳聞有關...

scripts.text: Ohhhh?! yeah Wolfchev!! That's right, the name was Wolfchev.. The mad scientist..
scripts.translation: 哦哦哦？！對了，沃爾夫切夫！！沒錯，是沃爾夫切夫...那個瘋狂的科學家...

scripts.text: I suppose you can then understand the story faster... I am sure that he's involved in the rumor. I swear.
scripts.translation: 我想你現在應該更容易明白這件事了...我敢肯定他和傳聞有關。我發誓。

scripts.text: By the way..what about you? Is there anything that you know about him?
scripts.translation: 對了...你呢？你知道他的什麼事嗎？

scripts.text: Not really. I've ever heard of his name, but I don't know anything about him..
scripts.translation: 不太清楚。我聽說過他的名字，但對他一無所知...

scripts.text: Hm.... You sound suspicious, dude! huh?
scripts.translation: 嗯...你聽起來很可疑啊，老兄！是吧？

scripts.text: He happens to research into Human 'Homunculus' without telling that to Rekenber Corp., and there was a whistle-blower who reported to the corp. so he was fired.
scripts.translation: 他瞞著雷根貝勒公司研究人類“生命體”，後來有人向公司告發，於是他被解僱了。

scripts.text: Oh! Man..! You seem to know pretty much! By any chance, are you concerned with Rekenber??
scripts.translation: 哦！老兄！你似乎知道不少嘛！你該不會和雷根貝勒有關係吧？

scripts.text: Don't worry. I didn't mean anything.
scripts.translation: 別擔心，我沒有別的意思。

scripts.text: Well! I am just curious only because some people in the slum and some adventurers were missing,
scripts.translation: 只是貧民區有些人和一些冒險者失蹤了，我才會感到好奇，

scripts.text: and I heard that Rekenber was doing human experimentation with those missing people. Hope you don't get me wrong.
scripts.translation: 而且我聽說雷根貝勒用那些失蹤者進行人體實驗。別誤會我。

scripts.text: Actually, it is not a funny rumor.
scripts.translation: 其實，這可不是有趣的傳聞。

scripts.text: Should investigate the lab where the experiment was carried out.
scripts.translation: 應該去調查進行實驗的研究所。

scripts.text: How come a beauty is here, in a place with dangerous rumor?
scripts.translation: 這麼危險的傳聞之地，怎麼會有如此美麗的女士？

scripts.text: Ahh.. Lady, you are so graceful even when you are just walking.....
scripts.translation: 啊...女士，即使只是走路也如此優雅...

scripts.text: Lady. You are a dignified lady even if you hang out in this poor town...
scripts.translation: 女士，即使在這個貧窮的小鎮出入，也依然高貴...

scripts.text: Ahh.. Lady.. Shopping in the slum!!.. Are you a type who needs to look around every single shop?
scripts.translation: 啊...女士...在貧民區購物！！您是那種每家店都要逛一遍的人嗎？

scripts.text: Well, how dare I ask you and be interested in what the lady does...
scripts.translation: 我怎麼敢過問女士的事，還對您做什麼感興趣呢...

scripts.text: I just hope that the lady gets out of this town with dangerous rumors..
scripts.translation: 我只希望女士能離開這個充滿危險傳聞的小鎮...

scripts.text: Ah... Lady may not have heard of the rumor.
scripts.translation: 啊...女士可能還沒聽說這個傳聞。

scripts.text: Recently, some people from this town, actually from the slum...and some adventurers are missing...
scripts.translation: 最近鎮上有些人，尤其是貧民區的人...還有一些冒險者失蹤了...

scripts.text: and then the rumor came up, since disappearance cases happen pretty often, that Rekenber is committing a horrible human experimentation in their secret lab.
scripts.translation: 因為失蹤事件頻頻發生，才傳出雷根貝勒在秘密研究所進行可怕人體實驗的傳聞。

scripts.text: There are a lot of rumors that horrible human experimentation is actually performed, but these people in the slum....don't want to believe that due to the welfare movement from Rekenber.
scripts.translation: 有很多傳聞說他們真的在做可怕的人體實驗，可貧民區的這些人...因為雷根貝勒的福利活動，不願相信這種事。

scripts.text: Well! the rich people either want to believe..I think.. Ah!! And couple of weeks ago. um. what's his name? Wolfchev??
scripts.translation: 有錢人嘛！他們大概也不願相信...我是這麼想的...啊！！幾個星期前，那個叫什麼來著？沃爾夫切夫？

scripts.text: Anyway!! that research got fired from the lab. I think he must be involved with this rumor.
scripts.translation: 總之！！那個研究員被研究所解僱了。我想他一定和這個傳聞有關。

scripts.text: So, please, lady. Please don't be in a place like this and stay in safe ways.
scripts.translation: 所以，女士，請不要待在這種地方，務必注意安全。

scripts.text: ............ It seems a pretty serious matter.
Should investigate the lab where the experiment was carried out.
scripts.translation: 應該去調查進行實驗的研究所。

scripts.text: Take care yourself and don't disappear!
Only those beautiful ladies are the reason of my life~!
scripts.translation: 那些美麗的女士就是我活下去的理由～！

scripts.text: I, Giacomo Girolamo Casanova de Seingalt am never interested in guys like you though!!
scripts.translation: 我，賈科莫·吉羅拉摩·卡薩諾瓦·德·塞恩加爾，對你這種傢伙可沒興趣！！

scripts.text: but I can listen to you...you wanna say anything to me?
scripts.translation: 不過我可以聽你說...你想對我說什麼嗎？

scripts.text: Hey you, get out of my way then..
I don't feel like talking about my precious ladies making fun of them. You do it with your friends.
scripts.translation: 我可不想拿我珍愛的女士們開玩笑。你去和朋友聊吧。

scripts.text: Hey.. Excuse me!!! but I'm not a 'Womanizer', I am just a person who adores ladies.
scripts.translation: 喂...打擾一下！！！我可不是“花花公子”，我只是個仰慕女士的人。

scripts.text: Of course..... Yea... If I'm a womanizer, all the men on earth are too! I'm just Casanova. umhahahaha.
scripts.translation: 當然...沒錯...如果我是花花公子，那全世界的男人都是！我只是卡薩諾瓦。嗯哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text: Haa.. Do you....? not have any woman but your sister and mother around you?
scripts.translation: 唉...你身邊除了姐姐和母親之外...沒有別的女人嗎？

scripts.text: Oh...... sorry.. I got your point....
scripts.translation: 哦...抱歉...我明白你的意思了...

scripts.text: You.. are not like how you seem? Interesting..
scripts.translation: 你...和表面看起來不一樣？有意思...

scripts.text: Yea, actually recently a lot of people from the slum and some wandering adventurers got disappeared. and I don't know why.
scripts.translation: 沒錯，最近貧民區有很多人，還有一些四處遊歷的冒險者失蹤了。我也不知道為什麼。

scripts.text: Wasn't it painful when you fell down from Heaven, my Angel?
scripts.translation: 從天堂摔下來一定很疼吧，我的天使？

scripts.text: You must be tired. Because you are always wandering my mind.
scripts.translation: 你一定累了，因為你總是在我的腦海裡徘徊。

scripts.text: Are you not tired of walking around in my dream last night?
scripts.translation: 昨晚在我的夢裡四處漫步，你不累嗎？

scripts.text: Excuse me. But I think I lost my heart. Could you please borrow me yours?
scripts.translation: 不好意思，我好像把心弄丟了。可以借我你的心嗎？

scripts.text: Do you believe in love at first sight?? Or can we start again..?
scripts.translation: 你相信一見鍾情嗎？還是說...我們可以重新開始？

scripts.text: I am so sorry but, can you kiss with a person who just met?? Noo? Ok then let me introduce myself.
scripts.translation: 不好意思，你願意親吻一個剛認識的人嗎？不願意？好吧，那我先自我介紹。

scripts.text: I'm so lost here since it's the first time. Can you let me know which is the way to your heart?
scripts.translation: 我第一次來這裡，完全迷路了。可以告訴我怎麼走進你的心嗎？

scripts.text: Give me a map please.. To get a way....I'm fallen in your eyes.
scripts.translation: 請給我一張地圖...告訴我怎麼離開...我已經陷入你的眼眸了。

scripts.text: Your eyes....I wanna be forever there.
scripts.translation: 你的眼睛...我想永遠待在那裡。

scripts.text: I promise that I will be your everything in any case, in any difficult situation.
scripts.translation: 無論發生什麼，無論遇到什麼困難，我都保證會成為你的一切。

scripts.text: Today is the first day we met, but I love you, Lady <3
scripts.translation: 今天才是我們初次見面，但我愛你，女士 <3

scripts.text: And I am telling you this because I'm just worried about you. You need to get out of this town which is full of disappearance cases.
scripts.translation: 我告訴你這些，只是因為擔心你。這裡失蹤事件頻發，你應該離開這個小鎮。

scripts.text: In order to investigate human experimentation, I had to go down whilst I didn't want to because of gruesome sound.
scripts.translation: 下方傳來的聲響令人毛骨悚然，可為了調查人體實驗，還是得硬著頭皮下去。

scripts.text: From below, there comes a gruesome sound mingling with the wind.
scripts.translation: 下方傳來一陣淒厲聲響，混雜在風聲之中。

scripts.text: I arrived at a research facility which seems it has been used till these days.
scripts.translation: 我來到一處研究設施，看起來最近仍有人使用。

scripts.text: There are some destroyed part, but the basic facility seem fine.
scripts.translation: 雖然有些地方受損，基本設施還算完好。

scripts.text: A Human! kaahaha. People tend to hate this place, why are you here?
scripts.translation: 人類！咔哈哈。大家都討厭這裡，你為什麼會來？

scripts.text: You!!! I heard that you were committing human experimentation. Wolfchev!!
scripts.translation: 你！！！沃爾夫切夫！我聽說你在進行人體實驗！

scripts.text: And I see that you are still committing that!!!
scripts.translation: 而且看來你現在還在做！！

scripts.text: Kihihihi. I can see that you know something about me. Is that you who accused me?
scripts.translation: 咿嘻嘻嘻。看來你知道我的一些事。是你告發我的嗎？

scripts.text: How dare you come back to me after you did that. Kihihih
scripts.translation: 你做了那種事之後，居然還敢回來找我。咿嘻嘻嘻。

scripts.text: I feel good to see a human
scripts.translation: 好久沒見到人類了，真令人愉快，

scripts.text: in a long time, but I gotta go. Kihihihi.
scripts.translation: 不過我得走了。咿嘻嘻嘻。

scripts.text: - Wolfchev ran away giving a awkward laughing sound. -
scripts.translation: - 沃爾夫切夫怪笑著跑開了。-

scripts.text: ^FF0000 Check up your inventory. You got too many items to carry out the quest. ^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000你攜帶的物品太多，無法繼續任務，請先整理背包。^000000

scripts.text: (Gasping) Pshaw... you are still following me. Hey, why do you keep following me?
scripts.translation: （喘氣）嘖...你還在跟著我。喂，你為什麼一直跟著我？

scripts.text: Wolfchev.. You said before. that you are doing research for everybody.
scripts.translation: 沃爾夫切夫...你之前說過，你是在為所有人做研究。

scripts.text: I might have said that.... so what?
But, your experiment seem really dangerous. How come this is what everybody wants?
scripts.translation: 可是你的實驗看起來非常危險。這怎麼會是所有人都想要的？

scripts.text: Everyone has a desire to be stronger and wants to dominate others so those other people obey and admire you. Do you not have that desire?
scripts.translation: 每個人都渴望變強，想要支配別人，讓別人服從並仰慕自己。你難道沒有這種慾望嗎？

scripts.text: If you want to save yourself, should stop following me. Bugger off.
scripts.translation: 想活命的話，就別再跟著我。滾開。

scripts.text: Wolfchev is again running away with a strange sound.
scripts.translation: 沃爾夫切夫又發出奇怪的聲音，跑開了。

scripts.text: Awwww!! You!! running away again..... Stop!
scripts.translation: 啊啊啊！！你！！又逃跑了...站住！

scripts.text: ^FF0000 Check up your inventory. You got too many items to carry out the quest. ^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000你攜帶的物品太多，無法繼續任務，請先整理背包。^000000

scripts.text: You are pretty persistent, aren't you? Or I think.......that you like me, huh? Kihihii.
scripts.translation: 你還真執著啊？還是說...你喜歡我？咿嘻嘻。

scripts.text: Wolfchev mocked you at your silence and pressed a button in his hand. Then guinea pigs woken up around him.
scripts.translation: 見你不作聲，沃爾夫切夫嘲笑了一番，按下手中的按鈕。周圍的實驗體隨即甦醒。

scripts.text: Again.. it's time to say goodbye.
scripts.translation: 又到了說再見的時候了。

scripts.text: If you come to me for the experimentation, I can treat you better.
scripts.translation: 如果你是來參加實驗的，我可以對你好一點。

scripts.text: No! Don't come to me! Don't!!
First of all, I gotta handle those guinea pigs!
Wolfchev is confused and has no idea now since those monsters are attacking him too.
scripts.translation: 連那些魔物也在攻擊沃爾夫切夫，他頓時慌了手腳。

scripts.text: - Hit him to wake him up -
scripts.translation: - 打他一下讓他清醒過來 -

scripts.text: Hey Dude! Anyway let's get out of here first! Isn't there any place where they cannot reach?
scripts.translation: 喂，老兄！總之我們先離開這裡！有沒有他們追不到的地方？

scripts.text: Oooops.. then my....my lab....to my lab...
scripts.translation: 糟了...我的...我的研究所...去我的研究所...
你的研究所？好吧，在哪裡？

scripts.text: to the north....... . Not so far from here..
Go to '^0000FFWolfchev's Lab^000000' at the 12 o'clock direction...
scripts.translation: 前往位於12點鐘方向的“^0000FF沃爾夫切夫的實驗室^000000”...

scripts.text: Wolfchev is confused and has no idea now since those monsters are attacking him too.
scripts.translation: 連那些魔物也在攻擊沃爾夫切夫，他頓時慌了手腳。

scripts.text: Go to '^0000FFWolfchev's Lab^000000' at the 12 o'clock direction...
scripts.translation: 前往位於12點鐘方向的“^0000FF沃爾夫切夫的實驗室^000000”...
我到達了“^0000FF沃爾夫切夫的實驗室^000000”。

scripts.text: I still have something to do with Wolfchev.
scripts.translation: 我還有事要和沃爾夫切夫談。

scripts.text: ^FF0000You cannot continue the process due to possessing too many belongings.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000你攜帶的物品太多，無法繼續，請先整理背包。^000000

scripts.text: What! Do you have any business here?
scripts.translation: 什麼事？你來這裡做什麼？

scripts.text: Why don't stop staring at other's laboratory, and be on your way?
scripts.translation: 別老盯著別人的研究所看，快走吧。

scripts.text: Stop wondering here, and be on your way. Will you? Khh Khh.
scripts.translation: 別在這裡徘徊了，快走。聽見沒有？咳咳。

scripts.text: It seems experimental creatures cannot come near the laboratory, just like Wolfchev said.
scripts.translation: 看來實驗生物確實無法靠近實驗室，正如沃爾夫切夫所說的那樣。

scripts.text: Hey, is there any way to stop those creatures? You should know something, you made those things!
scripts.translation: 喂，有辦法阻止那些生物嗎？是你製造了它們，你應該知道些什麼！

scripts.text: Urrgg.. I didn't expect them to loose control like that...
scripts.translation: 呃...我沒想到它們會失控...

scripts.text: What is wrong with this whole thing?
Urr.. I think they will ruin my whole laboratory!
scripts.translation: 呃...我想它們會毀掉我的整個研究所！

scripts.text: Creatures are ^9f6077organically connected with same job field^000000.
scripts.translation: 這些生物^9f6077按相同職業領域彼此有機連線^000000。

scripts.text: There is one special creature being their ^46B951boss position^000000...
scripts.translation: 其中有一個特殊生物擔任它們的^46B951首領^000000...

scripts.text: If you could deactivate that creature, all ^A1BB44slave creatures^000000 walking around here will stop moving right away.
scripts.translation: 只要你能關閉那個生物，四處活動的所有^A1BB44從屬生物^000000就會立刻停止行動。

scripts.text: Hey! Wolfchev! Where is that ^46B951Boss creature^000000?
scripts.translation: 喂！沃爾夫切夫！那個^46B951首領生物^000000在哪裡？

scripts.text: Inside.. of laboratory.. It should be waken up now. It's sad to destroy my life of work, but I can't take this any more.. ...
scripts.translation: 在...研究所裡面...它應該已經醒了。毀掉我畢生的研究成果很令人難過，但我不能再放任下去了...

scripts.text: How can I get into the Wolfchev's laboratory?
scripts.translation: 我要怎麼進入沃爾夫切夫的研究所？

scripts.text: I will help you get in there.
Good news is that boss creatures are not set up to wake up all at once, even though slaves are.
scripts.translation: 好訊息是，首領生物不會像從屬生物那樣同時醒來。

scripts.text: But still, it is really dangerous since we don't know when they will escape from there.
scripts.translation: 不過還是很危險，因為我們不知道它們什麼時候會逃出來。

scripts.text: So, please prepare your party members, and take care of those boss creatures. I'm not sure how long this place can hold.
scripts.translation: 所以請準備好隊伍成員，去處理那些首領生物。我也不知道這裡還能撐多久。

scripts.text: Are you all set there? I will prepare the entrance if you are the leader of that party.
scripts.translation: 都準備好了嗎？如果你是隊長，我就準備入口。

scripts.text: I didn't know pressing the emergency alarm would cause such problem. The management system seems to be changed to emergency mode.
scripts.translation: 我不知道按下緊急警報會引發這麼嚴重的問題。管理系統似乎切換到了緊急模式。

scripts.text: There are so many systems set up inside of the laboratory, so eve I cannot be sure how systems are twisted by now.
scripts.translation: 研究所裡設定了很多系統，現在連我也不知道它們被弄成什麼樣了。

scripts.text: Ah! If the emergency system is activating, only the leader of party should control everything. It is a lot of pressure I understand.
scripts.translation: 啊！緊急系統啟動後，只能由隊長操作一切。我知道這壓力很大。

scripts.text: And just so you know, please do not touch random things out of curiosity. I don't want you to get hurt.
scripts.translation: 另外，別因為好奇就亂碰東西。我不想你受傷。

scripts.text: I'm sorry, but it seems you still cannot enter to the laboratory yet. Will you come back later? The system is kind of tricky you know.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，你似乎還不能進入研究所。之後再來好嗎？這個系統有點複雜。

scripts.text: You came back, Ka Ha Ha.
After you left, I was fixing some system parts. And then suddenly strange thing happened.
scripts.translation: 你離開後，我一直在修理系統部件。然後突然發生了奇怪的事。

scripts.text: All those boss creatures you took care of started to regenerate themselves..
scripts.translation: 你處理過的那些首領生物開始再生了...

scripts.text: I am also completely lost here.. But, this should not be happening..
scripts.translation: 我也完全不明白...但這不應該發生...

scripts.text: As you can see, you are the only one I can trust. Would you and your party help me once again deactivating those creatures?
scripts.translation: 如你所見，現在我只能相信你了。你和隊伍能再幫我關閉那些生物嗎？

scripts.text: I see. I understand why you are hesitating, and don't want to press you any more. But, still I'm not sure why you want go there anyways,
scripts.translation: 我明白。也明白你為什麼猶豫，不想再勉強你。不過，我還是不懂你為什麼還想去那裡，

scripts.text: I will help you get in the laboratory right away.
scripts.translation: 我馬上幫你進入研究所。

scripts.text: Hmm.. Those boss creatures regenerating once again..
scripts.translation: 嗯...那些首領生物又再生了...

scripts.text: Can you help me just one more time?

scripts.text: You want to get in there fast, right?

scripts.text: Need more preparation? Please, we don't have all day.

scripts.text: Are you trying to go there along? That is a suicide! Our lab entering system is not as easy as you thinkz`.
scripts.translation: 你想獨自進去嗎？那是自尋死路！我們研究所的入口系統沒你想得那麼簡單。

scripts.text: Woot! Something weird just happen. If this keep happening, maybe we should try other way..

scripts.translation: 你遭到實驗室入口系統的攻擊，受了傷。

scripts.translation: 地上散落著閥門手冊的紙張。

scripts.text: You the party leader, started to read the manual.
scripts.translation: 作為隊長的你，開始閱讀手冊。

scripts.text: You finally defeated my Boss creature.
scripts.translation: 你終於打倒了我的首領生物。

scripts.text: Finally. is this the result?? For whom did I experiment? Did they cheat me?
scripts.translation: 終於...這就是結果嗎？我究竟是為了誰做實驗？他們騙了我嗎？

scripts.text: The button was supposed to be pressed for an emergency case...but..
scripts.translation: 緊急情況下才應該按下那個按鈕...可是...

scripts.text: Hey... You and I met by a bad connection....
scripts.translation: 喂...你我只是因為一次意外才相遇...

scripts.text: But...., you helped me... How could you do that?
scripts.translation: 可是...你幫了我...為什麼要這麼做？

scripts.text: When I met you for the first time, you seemed mad but sad, even if you could commit those cruel and horrific experiments.
scripts.translation: 第一次見到你時，你看起來既瘋狂又悲傷，儘管你竟然能做出那些殘忍可怕的實驗。

scripts.text: But actually, you did that because you was lonely,.. you just concentrated on that for this reason, huh?
scripts.translation: 但其實你只是因為孤獨才這麼做...只是因此把自己埋頭於實驗，對吧？
哈哈哈哈。孤獨...你是這麼想的嗎？

scripts.text: It might be seen like that to you. But, it isn't. Loneliness is just a good and easy excuse of the losers.
scripts.translation: 在你看來或許如此，但事實並非如此。孤獨只是失敗者找的輕鬆藉口。

scripts.text: I'm so happy doing experiments pursuing for a perfection, I never feel lonely.
scripts.translation: 我專注於追求完美的實驗，樂在其中，從不覺得孤獨。

scripts.text: Anyway, since I realized that Rekenber betrayed me, I cannot just let them do what they want.
scripts.translation: 總之，我發現雷根貝勒背叛了我，我不能放任他們為所欲為。

scripts.text: For now, I will leave them alone, but I will make them cry and regret for trying to remove Wolfchev.
scripts.translation: 我暫時會放過他們，但我會讓他們為試圖除掉沃爾夫切夫而哭泣、後悔。

scripts.text: aaaaaah, {0} Thank you so much to remove my boys who had gone mad. Not a big gift but I wish you don't deny, I don't need this anymore.
scripts.translation: 啊啊啊，{0}，謝謝你幫我除掉那些發狂的傢伙。禮物不貴重，但希望你不要拒絕，我已經用不上了。

scripts.text: And, if you can...hope you to come back often, especially with your friends. I want the place to be with human heart again so the sadness in here gets disappear.
scripts.translation: 如果可以的話...希望你常帶朋友回來。我想讓這裡重新有人情味，讓這裡的悲傷消散。

scripts.text: I looked at Wolfchev again before leaving his lab. and I could feel that he was not obsessed anymore..
scripts.translation: 離開實驗室前，我再次看了一眼沃爾夫切夫。我能感覺到，他不再那麼偏執了...

scripts.text: You did defeat all of the Boss creatures. Thank you again.
scripts.translation: 你打倒了所有首領生物。再次感謝你。

scripts.text: I say again, {0} Thank you so much to remove my boys who had gone mad. Not a big gift but I wish you don't deny, I don't need this anymore.
scripts.translation: 我再說一次，{0}，謝謝你幫我除掉那些發狂的傢伙。禮物不貴重，但希望你不要拒絕，我已經用不上了。

scripts.text: Khahaha, See you again. Do you want to get out of here now?
scripts.translation: 咔哈哈，再見。現在想離開這裡嗎？

scripts.text: Then tell me when you want to.
Then I will send you out.
I was looking at the system.... don't know who made this..... but it's so complicated to get..no idea...
scripts.translation: 我一直在研究這套系統...不知道是誰設計的...但太複雜了，根本沒法弄明白...

scripts.text: kakakaah.. Thank you. You handled those Boss creatures well...
scripts.translation: 咔咔咔...謝謝你。你把那些首領生物處理得很好...

scripts.text: I figured something out... and there's a system error which doesn't let us come and go freely, so you could help me in 72 hours... Go somewhere to rest before you come back.
scripts.translation: 我想明白了一些事...系統錯誤導致我們無法自由出入，所以72小時後你才能再幫我。先去什麼地方休息一下再回來吧。

scripts.text: Ah... and I can send you out of my laboratory. Do you want?
scripts.translation: 啊...我也可以送你離開研究所。你想出去嗎？

scripts.text: Do you want to get out of here now?
Then tell me when you want to.
Then I will send you out.
